gav_effect: No direct GAV effect is claimed as the basis for the patch. The change only prevents a portfolio-level XBRL total label from remaining in the source-only blocker pool.
patch_summary: Classify the exact Fidelity source-only label Investment Portfolio as a non-position total/header residual in source-only blocker classification.
primary_justification: The only blocker row is the XBRL investmentidentifieraxis value Investment Portfolio, with portfolio-level cost, fair value, and percent-of-net-assets facts and no issuer, tranche, rate, maturity, or share evidence. The bounded patch treats this exact label as a total/header residual and covers it with regression tests.
residual_risk: Residual risk is limited to exact portfolio-total labels. No issuer-bearing or instrument-bearing rows are reclassified by this verdict.
reviewer_notes: Manual review found this is not insufficient evidence. HTML source-row coordinates are absent for this blocker, so the verdict relies on the bundled XBRL source row and exact-label patch/test coverage.
source_reconciliation_effect: Expected effect is to move this source-only row out of the blocking pool as an aggregate/header residual while preserving real position rows.
tests_validation_plan: Covered by targeted source reconciliation tests in tests/test_validate_holdings.py; validate this verdict with python scripts/bdc_cik_review/validate_verdicts.py --output-dir data/output/bdc_cik_review --all.
